verdict.rationale: v0 is an AI agent, so in-product AI suggestions are a fair axis. The docs show it analyzing your project's own data: it reads deployment logs, diagnoses failures, and applies fixes ('Fix with v0', 'Fix Build'), and it offers intelligent diagnostics that automatically fix code errors. That covers insights from code and build data, but nothing shows it producing analytical insights or suggestions from your app's connected business data (e.g., the Postgres or Supabase integrations). Missing for 10: AI insights over connected or user-supplied datasets, proactive suggestion surfaces beyond error fixing, independent or hands-on corroboration of the diagnostic features.
